communication_data_handoff.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_data_handoff.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (28 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_data_handoff.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

workflow_parallelization.title: Parallel Execution of stock_policy_agent and demand_forecast_agent
workflow_parallelization.observed_problem: Agents 'stock_policy_agent' (1.61s) and 'demand_forecast_agent' (3.74s) are currently executed sequentially (total: 5.35s), despite having completely independent processing scopes and no mutual data dependencies.

supporting_evidence.dependency_verification: Verified independent: No direct/transitive edge between stock_policy_agent and demand_forecast_agent, and no shared I/O coupling.

workflow_parallelization.proposed_solution: Execute 'stock_policy_agent' and 'demand_forecast_agent' concurrently using an asynchronous scatter-gather branch. Join their outputs prior to downstream synthesis.

expected_benefit.critical_path_impact: Cuts 1.61s directly from sequential critical path.
expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero impact on output quality since dependencies are strictly verified.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: No additional token cost (concurrent execution uses separate Groq keys).

model_selection.title: Route inventory_intake_agent to openai/gpt-oss-20b (JEV Agent 2 Recommendation; requires validation)
model_selection.observed_problem: Agent 'inventory_intake_agent' performs structured syntactic extraction and text normalization. Assigning the high-parameter 120B model ('openai/gpt-oss-120b') introduces unnecessary latency (15.22s) and compute overhead for straightforward parsing tasks.
model_selection.proposed_solution: Switch 'inventory_intake_agent' from 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' to 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' per the 2-agent JEV LangGraph workflow (Agent 2 recommendation) with structured schema output validation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Requires shadow validation against baseline traces to confirm behavioral equivalence.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: ~50.0% API pricing reduction vs. 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' based on Groq catalog rates.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Moderate (compact model recommended by JEV Agent 2 requires empirical shadow validation against baseline traces).
